title: Skewer the Queen
setup: The black king on e5 and the black queen on e8 are standing on the same file, with the king in front.
hint: Get on that file with check. Then ask what the king is standing in front of.
explanation:
## The Idea

The more valuable piece is the nearer one. That is a skewer: hit the piece in front and take what it was hiding.

{{Re1+}} claims the file. All six answers are king moves — nothing can block, because the queen would have to travel through its own king to reach e2, e3 or e4.

{{Kd6}} is as good as any, and {{Rxe8}} collects the queen. In a pin the valuable piece is behind; in a skewer it is in front, and moving costs.
